did.unittitle: Department of African American Studies, Yale University, records
did.abstract: The records consist of student records, photographs, scrapbook pages, event ephemera, and audio-visual materials from the Department of African American Studies.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Access to the collection is partially restricted. See Collection Contents for details.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The records were transferred from the Department of African American Studies in 2022.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The records are arranged by accession.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The records consist of student records, photographs, scrapbook pages, event ephemera, and audio-visual materials from the Department of African American Studies.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Department of African American Studies, Yale University, Records (RU 1183). Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University Library.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Student records are restricted until January 1, 2097. Scrapbook pages, photographs, event posters and subject files are open for research.

Original audiovisual materials, as well as preservation and duplicating masters, may not be played. Researchers must consult use copies, or if none exist must pay for a use copy, which is retained by the repository. Researchers wishing to obtain an additional copy for their personal use should consult Copying Services information on the Manuscripts and Archives web site.
